title: Objects and Odometry
description: Write an abstract OI class, then use WPILib kinematics, a NavX gyro and a pose estimator to track where the robot is.

checkpoints.title: OI class
checkpoints.description: OI has static getForward() and getTurn() methods, and Robot.java uses them instead of XboxController.

checkpoints.title: Chassis speeds
checkpoints.description: Drive forward at full speed. Drive/LinearSpeed (from kinematics) should read about 6 m/s.

checkpoints.title: Yaw
checkpoints.description: Write getWheelYaw() and getYaw() (from the gyro), then spin the robot counterclockwise (left). Drive/PoseYawRad should become clearly positive.

checkpoints.title: Drive to x = 3 m
checkpoints.description: Run Auto and let the robot stop. Drive/PoseX should read about 3 meters (it coasts a little past, to about 3.7).

checkpoints.title: Challenge: Waypoint tour
checkpoints.description: Optional, for students who want more. Run Auto. The robot drives to (2.0, 1.0), then to (3.5, -1.0), and stops there, in under 10 seconds, measured by its true position. See "Advanced challenge" in the README.
